text: After this you can use a suitable energy indicator to compare transport operations.

Study fleet and transport energy in relation to the work performed. Record vehicle types, fuel or electricity, distances, route profiles, loads, maintenance, and operating practice. A change in payload or route can distort a simple before-and-after fuel comparison. Select an indicator that reflects useful transport service and investigate measured consumption rather than relying solely on published vehicle performance figures.

items: Inferred: Illustrative case: Delivery runs differ in length and payload. Compare energy per distance and equivalent delivery service, not merely fuel totals.

text: Use a transport indicator tied to the service performed.
Distance alone may omit load, route, or operating changes.
